title: 7-Year Treasury Note auction — the January block's last leg, the day after the FOMC decision
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by the treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-21 initial research, text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised into 213 rows. Row reads `7-Year  NOTE / Announcement Thursday, January 21, 2027 / Auction Thursday, January 28, 2027 / Settlement Monday, February 01, 2027`, with NO trailing `R` against the PDF's own `R --denotes reopening` legend. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2027-01-21 announcement itself. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-21 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09) and proposed because its proposer is the announcement that sizes it. FOMC POSITION: the 2027-01-26/27 FOMC (federalreserve.gov FOMC calendar, fetched direct this session, HTTP 200) makes this the first coupon auction after the statement — the only leg of the block that sells into a KNOWN policy setting rather than an unknown one. THE WEEKDAY IS NOT A HOLIDAY DISPLACEMENT, unlike the 2026-11-25 sibling: Thursday is the 7-Year's ordinary slot (4 of 6 months in the schedule's Aug-2026-to-Jan-2027 window auction Thursday; November and December are the holiday exceptions), so the 1:00 p.m. ET close applies rather than the 11:30 a.m. one the pre-Thanksgiving ledger sourced — fiscaldata `closing_time_comp` reads `01:00 PM` on 133 of 140 7-Year auctions. SIZE EXPECTATION $44B, unchanged at every 7-Year auction since 2024-04-25 (28 auctions, 28 months). DEMAND BASELINE from fiscaldata auctions_query pulled this session (n=140 since 2015): pool bid-to-cover mean 2.487, sd 0.132; the 14 that auctioned the day AFTER an FOMC decision averaged 2.480 (z -0.06) — the cleanest null in the whole straddle measurement, on the largest single-offset sample it has. Since 2024-05 the 7-Year has never printed below 2.40 (28 of 28), which is the floor the proposer's forward test uses. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
